hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && h=$(shasum -a 256 .hooks.json 2>/dev/null | cut -d" " -f1); p=$(grep -o 'CONFIG_SHA256: &str = "[0-9a-f]*"' utils/rs/kg/src/hooks.rs | grep -o '[0-9a-f]\{64\}'); if [ -z "$h" ] || [ "$h" != "$p" ] || ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- utils/rs/kg/src/hooks.rs; then echo "SERVE HOOKS TAMPERED: .hooks.json is missing or changed, or the hook runner has uncommitted edits. Follow the Serve hooks rule in CLAUDE.md."; fi; true
